name: Size-Exclusion Chromatography
mechanism: Separate compatible dissolved chains by their access to a qualified porous stationary phase and measure a calibrated elution profile within a finite size range.
operating_requirement: Pay for compatible porous column medium, stable pump flow, concentration-sensitive detection, sample preparation, eluent, reference standards and finite acquisition; establish retention calibration, recovery and separation resolution before interpreting the trace.
consequence: Measured relative size-distribution evidence distinguishes supported retained PEG samples with different distributions and informs a paid selected binder or process choice; unresolved or out-of-range material cannot receive a distribution grade.
branching_note: Selected aqueous analytical route; the listed game foundations do not claim a unique historical pathway. Polymer size exclusion is distinct from biological affinity/phase-interaction chromatography.
recovery: Obtain attributable column and detector instruction or finite qualified external analysis; pay delivery, local setup and calibration before independent use.

recovery_contract.local_demonstration: Separate compatible dissolved chains by their access to a qualified porous stationary phase and measure a calibrated elution profile within a finite size range.
recovery_contract.operating_requirements: Pay for compatible porous column medium, stable pump flow, concentration-sensitive detection, sample preparation, eluent, reference standards and finite acquisition; establish retention calibration, recovery and separation resolution before interpreting the trace.

route_terms.scholar_envoy: Pay a reachable analyst, travel and supervised local column setup, reference injections and sample interpretation.
route_terms.partnership: Provide actual retained specimens, eluent and operator time for reciprocal calibrated analysis; preserve provenance of delivered traces.
route_terms.purchased_research: Commission a finite distribution question with actual sample delivery and uncertainty-bearing results; no automatic useful grade.
route_terms.licensed_or_imported_service: Purchase finite compatible column packing, characterized narrow standards or analysis from an actual reachable qualified supplier; delivered stock and temporary permission do not grant its synthesis.
route_terms.reverse_engineering: Inspect an attributable column/detector and reproduce its measured separation with paid local trials; pore chemistry and reference provenance cannot be inferred from appearance.

implementation_status: Authored proposal only. Runtime promotion requires paid physical column/flow/detection, attributable standard and medium supply, observed calibration and sample traces, resolution and out-of-range rejection, finite saved acquisition, and a consumer or process decision using distribution evidence. An inventory label or a number-mean estimate alone is insufficient.
historical_scope: H05 classifies the selected analytical capability, not a calendar gate. Source descriptions support the method; game prerequisites, assay bounds and operating contracts are design inferences.
